mathematics.assertion_tested: In Q[i][z,z^-1], the complete fourth Hamilton-Jacobi momentum coefficient from the three recursive formulas equals (i^3/96)D_4^3(u^4), and its mode two coefficient yields -25823/4800000000000 in units pi^4*tau^4. Also verify the Gauss identity for every odd N residue and every d residue modulo 8.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational complex pairs Q[i]; exact Z[zeta_8] residues
mathematics.conventions: D_n(z^k)=i(k-3n/4)z^k with kappa set to 1; g_n has separately proved homogeneity kappa^(2n-2). u=(-3-4i)R/1000, R=(1+cos 7q)(1-cos q).
inputs: The explicit nine Fourier coefficients of R
All four odd N residues and all eight d residues modulo 8
non_claims: No proof or counterexample to H_diag
The analytic and asymptotic arguments are outside this finite computation
